title: Piaget Boutique Entrance Portal — Illuminated Signage & Backlit Ceiling: From Inquiry to Acceptance
excerpt: How Guoyao Metalwork delivered the entrance portal for a Piaget boutique — structural steel frame, deep black lacquer fascia, illuminated PIAGET lettering and a perforated backlit ceiling — 18 documented stages from the first inquiry through workshop trial assembly, export packing and mall installation to final acceptance and aftercare, with 23 project photographs.
category: Luxury retail · Boutique entrance portal + illuminated signage
coverImageAlt: The completed PIAGET boutique entrance portal standing lit in the workshop for mock-up review, black lacquer fascia and warm illuminated lettering

images.alt: The kickoff meeting.
Site survey inside the hoarded boutique unit: laser meter, tape checks and a marked-up portal drawing — recording opening levels, soffit heights and power points rather than three overall…
Design development.
The sealed sample set: black lacquer, brushed gold, a perforated ceiling panel glowing through its dot matrix, and an illuminated letter built to production detail — the contractual finish…
Squaring and welding the portal's steel sections on the workshop floor: uprights braced plumb, head beam tacked to the drawing's dimension — the frame that everything else hangs from.
A fascia panel through the finishing line: deep gloss black checked under booth lighting at raking angle — no wave, no orange peel, no dust before a panel is released.
The illuminated lettering at close range on the backlit panel: warm glow even across the full name, typographic edges crisp, halo falling softly onto the perforated surface behind.
The lit fascia read from below — the angle every guest actually sees.
The portal standing in the workshop under trial assembly — black fascia, the name already glowing, scaffold at the head.
The trial from the hall's far side: the full portal lit in the workshop, checked from the distance a mall customer would first see it.
Closing the head junction from the scaffold — the ceiling-to-fascia detail proven under real access conditions before it meets the mall's soffit.
Panels under protective film during the height rehearsal: reveals, letter alignment and corner returns walked through the checking list before anything is packed.
The portal corner in close view — two black elevations meeting in one continuous line, the joint the brand's designers examine longest.
The complete portal under mock-up review: front elevation lit, film still on, every glow state checked from the customer viewing distance.
The portal read from directly beneath — the entrance soffit, ceiling wash and fascia reveals composing the view every guest walks through.
Final inspection under the work lamp: joint lines and letter glow checked item by item against the QC sheet, scaffold standing by — nothing approved from memory.
A wrapped fascia panel entering its plywood crate — foam lining, edge protectors and desiccant in place, crate labelled to the installation sequence.
Container loading at the factory: crates guided up the ramp onto a padded deck, blocked and strapped to the loading plan before sealing.
Setting the portal inside the mall unit: scaffold at the head, fascia aligned to the survey line, protection down — the rehearsed sequence, repeated on site.
Leveling the fascia base at the floor joint: shims set, spirit level centred — the invisible pass that makes the portal read as one plane.
Evening commissioning at the storefront: lettering and ceiling wash checked against the workshop baseline from the customer distance, the black fascia reading deep under mall light.
The acceptance walk: brand projects manager and our project lead through the finished boutique with the punch list, against the mock-up standard and the commissioning log.
Aftercare in practice: the fascia wiped to its approved gloss on the first scheduled service visit — the maintenance the portal was designed to receive.
